Same chronic noise, no action needed.

2) KNOWN-ISSUE-RECURRENCE ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout (occ 745->746), SUPPRESSED (known-issue-window, last DM ~15h ago): monitor 77419271 XHR-errors fired 12:07Z. Same Ocelot ResponderMiddleware timeout mechanism as always, BUT magnitude is 32-48x the 24h-ago baseline this hour (confirmed across 20min/1h/4h windows, not a sampling fluke) -- well above this entry's usual ~10-20% chronic delta. Spread across 10+ accounts (no single-tenant concentration), so infrastructure-shaped not account-specific. Per this entry's own 2026-06-04 lesson, a >10x surge warrants checking ms-account-api/ms-preferences-api deploys -- but that check is blocked: methodcrm-org GH_TOKEN 403s on fetch and local clones are months stale. Recommend checking TFS deploy history directly for ms-account-api/ms-preferences-api around 2026-08-31 11:00-12:10Z. Flagging since the score-gate would otherwise let this pass silently as routine chronic noise.
